description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing whitespace handling, diff output, and move detection in a Git environment. It contains multiple test cases for various scenarios involving whitespace, diff options, color output, and move detection functionalities.

methods.name: test_expect_success

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output or files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_decode_color

methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.
